text: ポケモンを　いれかえた　だけでも　こっちの　ばんは　おわってしまうよ　さあ　こんどは　むこうの　ばんだぞ！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　いれかえた　だけでも
こっちの　ばんは　おわってしまうよ
さあ　こんどは　むこうの　ばんだぞ！
structure.en: now, this time it's the other side's turn!

patterns.name: 〜だけでも
patterns.span: いれかえた　だけでも
patterns.explanation: だけ means 'only' and でも adds 'even', so together they say 'even if you do nothing more than this'. いれかえた だけでも = 'even just switching'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happens completely, with no going back. おわってしまう = 'ends up being over'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, manly way of pushing your point. ばんだぞ = 'it's their turn, look out!'
